# FastSEO Solutions

> FastSEO Solutions is an international SEO agency specialising in restricted and regulated niches that most agencies refuse to work in. We provide organic search, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), link building, technical SEO, and AI search visibility services for iGaming, cryptocurrency, adult, cannabis, dental, and SaaS brands worldwide.

FastSEO Solutions helps brands in competitive and regulated industries rank on Google and get cited by AI assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot. Our specialist teams have deep vertical expertise — we do not take a generalist approach. Every client gets a dedicated specialist, transparent reporting, and strategies built specifically for their niche's competitive environment and regulatory constraints.

Contact: seo@fastseosolutions.com — replies within 24 hours, currently accepting new clients.

## Services

- [iGaming SEO](https://www.fastseosolutions.com/igaming-seo/): Specialist SEO for online casinos, sports betting platforms, poker rooms, and iGaming affiliate sites. Deep expertise in regulated UK, EU, and Tier 1 markets.
- [Cryptocurrency SEO](https://www.fastseosolutions.com/cryptocurrency-seo/): SEO for crypto exchanges, DeFi protocols, NFT projects, blockchain gaming, and Web3 brands. Organic acquisition strategies where paid ads are restricted.
- [Adult SEO](https://www.fastseosolutions.com/adult-seo/): SEO for adult content platforms, porn sites, escort agencies, cam sites, sex toy eCommerce, exotic dancers, and dominatrix/BDSM services. Pre-built adult publisher network for link building.
- [Cannabis SEO](https://www.fastseosolutions.com/cannabis-seo/): SEO for CBD eCommerce stores, cannabis dispensaries, hemp wellness brands, and marijuana information sites. Compliant content and link building in a restricted ad environment.
- [Dental SEO](https://www.fastseosolutions.com/dental-seo/): Local SEO for multi-location dental practices and dental groups. Patient acquisition through organic search across multiple cities and regions.
- [SaaS SEO](https://www.fastseosolutions.com/saas-seo/): Organic growth strategies for B2B and B2C SaaS platforms. Product-led SEO, topical authority, and trial/signup conversion optimisation.
- [AI SEO & AEO Services](https://www.fastseosolutions.com/ai-seo-services/): Answer Engine Optimisation to get your brand cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and Apple Intelligence. Entity building, schema markup, conversational content, and AI visibility monitoring.
